title: The 5 Best Patio Heaters Under $150
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for patio heaters under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at patio heaters under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fire Sense 60262 Tabletop Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 10,000 BTU propane burner, Stainless steel construction, Auto-shutoff tilt valve.
strengths: Auto-shutoff tilt valve is a genuine safety feature not always included at this price
Stainless steel holds up better outdoors than painted or coated budget finishes
limitations: Smaller heat radius than a full-size standing heater
Runs on small 1lb cylinders rather than a full tank

products.name: Mr. Heater 11,000 BTU Table Top Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 to 11,000 BTU adjustable output, 1lb propane cylinder compatible, Piezo push-button ignition.
strengths: Adjustable output is unusual at this price point
Compact enough to double as a small-patio or table heater
limitations: Smaller brand track record than Fire Sense in this category

products.name: Mr. Heater MH48PH 48,000 BTU Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 48,000 BTU propane burner, Rated coverage up to 215 square feet, Standard 20lb tank compatible.
strengths: 215 square foot rated coverage is enough for most single-family patios
Uses a standard 20lb tank, no special cylinders to source
limitations: Fewer long-term owner reviews than more established standing heaters
Finish quality is a step below premium hammered-bronze models
Some variants skip the wheeled base included on pricier competitors
features: Rated coverage up to 215 square feet

products.name: Hiland HLDS032-B Tabletop Patio Heater, 11,000 BTU
strengths: Warms a table area without floor space
Runs on 1 lb or 20 lb propane
